rule: Candidate source paths are hypotheses, not verified implementation, do not auto-close

rows.title: Add supported AI account adapters
originalAcceptance: Each shipped provider has a real no-key sign-in and completed model request with evidence.
Unavailable provider capabilities remain visibly unavailable rather than simulated.

rows.title: Build general code generation and refactoring
originalAcceptance: Real coding tasks change application behavior correctly and pass relevant tests.
Unsupported edits and stale baselines are rejected with recoverable errors.

rows.title: Complete repository delivery and CI evidence
originalAcceptance: A real branch → candidate → tests → draft PR flow is proven on a test repository.
Retry cannot silently duplicate or overwrite unrelated work.

rows.title: Generate delivery, migration and infrastructure artifacts
originalAcceptance: Representative generated artifacts validate and run in an authorized test environment.
Destructive changes and unsupported versions cannot execute silently.

rows.title: Add language-aware and runtime discovery
originalAcceptance: Fixtures and authorized real projects show correct entities and relationships.
Unsupported languages and incomplete snapshots are labeled as coverage gaps.

rows.title: Expand the missing-things engine
originalAcceptance: Known gaps are detected with actionable evidence and acceptable measured false-positive rates.
Incomplete snapshots and business hypotheses do not become unsupported factual claims.

rows.title: Build real security intelligence
originalAcceptance: Known vulnerabilities and remediations are validated against test fixtures and authorized targets.
Coverage, false positives and source freshness are visible.

rows.title: Implement authorization beyond a single owner
originalAcceptance: Unauthorized users cannot access any project data, credential or action.
Sharing does not expose a previously single-owner API.

rows.title: Complete credential and provider-boundary audit
originalAcceptance: Security review findings are recorded and fixed or explicitly dispositioned.
Tests exercise material failure paths and no secrets appear in logs/exports.

rows.title: Verify hosted end-to-end behavior
originalAcceptance: Hosted user journeys and access boundaries pass with captured evidence.
Publication alone is never recorded as external integration success.

rows.title: Test actual application behavior
originalAcceptance: Behavioral bugs and regressions cause meaningful failures.
Passing snapshot-integrity checks is not presented as application correctness.

rows.title: Add performance, resilience and evaluation suites
originalAcceptance: Measured results demonstrate stated capacity and reliability limits.
Evaluation artifacts and failures remain searchable.
Incident/control capacity remains available under noisy-neighbor load; supported SLOs and economic usage limits match observed profiles.

rows.title: Ingest real health telemetry
originalAcceptance: Authorized target failures produce accurate incidents and recoveries with timestamps.
Stale/missing telemetry cannot produce a false healthy state.

rows.title: Build production diagnosis and repair loop
originalAcceptance: An induced test-environment incident is detected, diagnosed, repaired, checked and safely rolled back on failure.
No unsupported production action is claimed or performed.

rows.title: Add deployment and rollback adapters
originalAcceptance: A real authorized staging deployment and rollback are verified.
Wrong-target, stale-plan and unsafe/destructive actions are rejected.

rows.title: Operate OmniDev itself reliably
originalAcceptance: Platform outages and stale workers generate actionable alerts.
Recovery and maintenance runbooks are exercised.

rows.title: Build project digital twins
originalAcceptance: Predictions are calibrated against real staging outcomes and documented uncertainty.
Twin changes cannot affect production or expose sensitive data.

rows.title: Add cost and revenue impact models
originalAcceptance: Scenarios trace to real input data and explicitly distinguish forecasts from facts.
Revenue and cost access is permission-controlled.

rows.title: Replace future-state templates with evaluated plans
originalAcceptance: Every horizon has project-specific evidence and testable milestones.
Predictions remain hypotheses with evaluations, not guaranteed futures.

rows.title: Connect product and business intelligence
originalAcceptance: Recommendations reference real evidence and measurable business objectives.
Sensitive business/customer data has scoped access and retention.

rows.title: Build innovation discovery and validation
originalAcceptance: Proposals include sources, competing solutions, validation plans and experimental results.
The system does not claim that nobody has built something without evidence.

rows.title: Complete executive intelligence scores
originalAcceptance: All 14 dimensions have documented methodology and evidence or an explicit unassessed state.
A score never implies a certification or unsupported measurement.

rows.title: Complete accessibility and responsive verification
originalAcceptance: Representative viewport and assistive-technology journeys pass with recorded findings.
All critical actions work without a mouse.

rows.title: Implement scoped compliance and legal auditing
originalAcceptance: Reports distinguish measured controls, missing evidence and legal interpretation.
No unsupported certification or legal conclusion is issued.

rows.title: Create reusable integration execution contracts
originalAcceptance: Every adapter follows a verified lifecycle and common capability/error contract.
Cross-source permission boundaries and revoked access are enforced.

rows.title: Prepare release documentation and operating evidence
originalAcceptance: A new authorized operator can set up, verify, recover and upgrade the platform using the docs.
Release notes accurately distinguish engineering work, activation and verification.

rows.title: Resolve the unused Vercel experiment
originalAcceptance: No unwanted running resources or required Vercel dependency remain.
Cleanup outcome is verified; absence of a supported delete operation is documented.
